Gates run independent adversarial checks: claude subagents plus `codex exec` where applicable (different model family, fresh context, no pane setup). Phase 7 auto-squashes bullet commits onto base, deletes the feature branch, removes the worktree and per-worktree Cargo target, and pings DONE-MERGED so sequential chained runs always start from a clean base. Includes the orchestration script, the tmux-pair-orchestration skill, PROJECT.md care, scoped subagents for the gates, sender identity prefixes, explicit parallel-plan markers, auto-detection of repo-specific subagents (`.claude/agents/<repo>-*.md`) listed in every briefing, shipped guidance templates for 7 stacks, bundled companion skills (gepa for prompt-optimization, dg for adversarial code review), and opt-in pi as a bulk-work coding agent. `/run` defaults to codex and switches to claude only for recon-heavy/plan-integration/greenfield/compliance profiles. Multi-pane spawn modes were removed in 0.19.0.
